audit_scope.description: This batch covers EL logic (EVM control flow, state clearing, access list transactions, difficulty calculation, P2P compression, JSON-RPC) and CL logic (Deneb fork choice with blob data availability, Electra P2P gossip/req-resp, EIP-7805 inclusion lists).

out_of_scope: Execution Layer internals from CL perspective

misclassified_entities.reason: Internal transaction processing stage within the EL, not an external entity crossing a trust boundary.
Internal execution lifecycle event within EL transaction processing, not an external entity.
Internal subprotocol layer (eth/les) within the same node, not an external entity crossing a system boundary.
EIP governance participant; EIP-5757 describes a governance process, not a runtime EL/CL interaction.
EIP governance role; not a runtime system interactor for EL or CL.
External resource origin provider for EIP governance; not a runtime EL/CL entity.

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer Node via P2P Network (devp2p/libp2p)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: DEVp2p TCP connection (blocks, transactions, compressed messages)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: P2P peers are unauthenticated. Any node can connect and send arbitrary data including malformed blocks, invalid transactions, or crafted compressed payloads (decompression bombs). Covers EXT-PEER-NODE, EXT-NETWORK-PEER, EXT-PEER-BLOCK, EXT-BLOCK-PRODUCER, EXT-NETWORK, EXT-MALICIOUS-PEER from source subgraphs.

trusted_external_entities.name: CL Peer Node via libp2p Gossip/ReqResp
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: libp2p gossipsub topics (beacon_block, beacon_attestation, blob_sidecar) and req/resp protocols (BeaconBlocksByRange, BlobSidecarsByRange)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: CL P2P peers are unauthenticated. They can send invalid beacon blocks, malformed attestations, blob sidecars exceeding limits, or oversized req/resp requests. Covers EXT-PEER-NODE and EXT-REQUESTING-PEER from Electra P2P subgraphs.

trusted_external_entities.name: P2P Blob Sidecar Network
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Blob sidecar retrieval via P2P (blob_sidecar subnets, BlobSidecarsByRange/Root)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Blob data is retrieved from unauthenticated P2P peers. Blobs may be withheld, invalid, or have failing KZG proofs. Data availability depends on honest majority of peers.

trusted_external_entities.name: Execution Engine via Engine API
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Authenticated via JWT between CL and EL on the same machine. However, content from the execution engine (payload attributes, inclusion list transactions) must still be validated. A compromised EL could return manipulated data.

trusted_external_entities.name: User/DApp via JSON-RPC
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Public JSON-RPC endpoint with no authentication required. Users can submit malformed transactions, access list transactions with oversized lists, or query blocks. Covers EXT-RPC-CLIENT, EXT-TX-SUBMITTER, EXT-TX-SENDER.

trusted_external_entities.name: Contract Deployer via Transaction
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Anyone can deploy contracts with arbitrary bytecode. The EVM must correctly validate JUMPDEST locations during bytecode analysis to prevent control flow hijacking. This is a subset of user transactions but has distinct security implications for jump destination validation.

trusted_external_entities.name: Validator via CL P2P (attestations, inclusion lists)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P gossip (SingleAttestation on beacon_attestation subnets, SignedInclusionList)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Validators are staked but individual validators can be malicious. They may submit invalid attestations, conflicting votes, or manipulated inclusion lists. Committee membership must be verified. Slashing provides economic deterrence but does not prevent attempts.

trusted_external_entities.name: Malicious Peer via Crafted Compressed Payload
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Attacker can send crafted Snappy payloads designed as decompression bombs (small compressed size, huge decompressed size). Size validation against 16MB limit and varint overflow checks are critical defenses.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Version negotiation must complete before compressed messages are processed. Peer hello messages must be validated for protocol version compatibility.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: DEVp2p message receive path (RLPx decryption + Snappy decompression)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Decompressed message size must be validated against 16MB limit before allocation. Snappy varint must be checked for overflow. Decompression failures must result in message rejection.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Block validation pipeline (header difficulty, fork activation)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Block difficulty must be recomputed and compared against claimed value. Fork activation rules (Arrow Glacier block number) must be correctly applied. Invalid blocks must be rejected.

Full transaction validation required: type byte, RLP decoding, field count, chain ID, signature verification, access list structure (20-byte addresses, 32-byte keys), and gas calculation (including access list costs). Malformed transactions must be rejected.
Response must correctly include or exclude baseFee field based on EIP-1559 fork activation status of the queried block. Invalid block hashes must return null.
KZG commitment count must not exceed MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK_ELECTRA. Block must pass all fork choice assertions (parent exists, timing valid, finalization lineage, data availability).
SingleAttestation data.index must equal 0. Attester must be verified as a member of the committee for the given slot. Duplicate attestations must be rejected.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Gossip validation (blob_sidecar subnet) and BlobSidecarsByRange/Root req/resp
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Blob index and KZG commitments must be validated against MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK_ELECTRA. KZG proofs must be batch-verified. Request sizes must not exceed MAX_REQUEST_BLOB_SIDECARS_ELECTRA.

Authenticated via JWT but content must be validated. Inclusion list transactions from the execution engine must be structurally valid. A compromised EL could return empty or manipulated lists, undermining censorship resistance.
PayloadAttributes including parent_beacon_block_root (EIP-4788) must be validated. The execution engine must faithfully construct payloads per the provided attributes.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: EVM bytecode loading and JUMPDEST scanning
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Valid jump destinations must be pre-computed by scanning bytecode and correctly skipping PUSH data bytes. JUMP/JUMPI must validate destinations against this whitelist. Invalid jumps must halt execution and consume all gas.

Varint size must be checked against 2^32-1 limit. Decompressed size must be validated against 16MB limit BEFORE decompression to prevent memory exhaustion. Connection must be terminated on overflow detection.
